gloss: with a thud; in large amounts

definitions.gloss: with heavy thuds; with repeated dull sounds
definitions.explanation: Describes the sound or manner of heavy objects falling or being dropped repeatedly.

definitions.gloss: in large amounts; one after another
definitions.explanation: Describes things arriving, falling, or accumulating in large quantities in succession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どさどさと⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Books fell from the shelf with heavy thuds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧どさどさと⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I set the luggage down on the floor with heavy thuds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どさどさと⟦{落|お}ちてきた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: Roof tiles came crashing down one after another in the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どさどさ⟦{入|はい}ってきた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どさどさと⟦{降|ふ}っている→降る：00839_furu⟧。
⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なると⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧どさどさと⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧だ。
examples.english: At the end of the year, work piles up in huge amounts and I end up working overtime every day.

notes:
どさどさ is an onomatopoeic word (⟦{擬音語|ぎおんご}→擬音語：22536_giongo⟧) that conveys both heaviness and repeated quantity. It evokes the sound and feel of heavy things falling or arriving one after another.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Often followed by と: どさどさと⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧, どさどさと⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どさどさと⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall with heavy thuds
- どさどさ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to come flooding in
- どさどさ⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: to pile up rapidly

RELATED ONOMATOPOEIA:
- どさっ(と): a single heavy thud (one-time event)
- ⟦ばたばた→ばたばた：05353_batabata⟧: repeated flapping or rushing around
- ⟦ぱたぱた→ぱたぱた：05992_patapata⟧: light pattering or flapping
- ⟦どかどか→どかどか：noentry⟧: heavy stomping; barging in
